## Reported facts

### Disclosure and retention burden

`[Reported disclosures, recipients, systems, retention periods, access, deletion, and burdens; distinguish policy from observed practice and use explicit missing-data markers.]`

### Assurance requirements

`[Reported provenance, authentication, authorization, time, coverage, custody, auditability, corroboration, and verifier requirements; record unknown or not asked where applicable.]`

### Observations

`[Reported observations, with references to provenance rows and quantities expressed with units, time windows, sample bases, and uncertainty.]`

### Contradictory evidence

`[Contradictions, disagreements, negative cases, or explicit none observed; do not resolve disagreements by omission.]`

### Missing or unasked topics

`[For every missing topic, mark not asked, unknown, not requested, withheld, or outside scope.]`
